_metadata.description: Requirement stubs scaffolded from the P1 operational targets.

requirements.description: Report the two-direction diff between the autoheal check registry and the derived should-be-supervised set: ghost checks and unsupervised plant. The set is computed at read time from the core-set closure and load-bearing declarations, never held as an enumerated roster.
requirements.title: Supervised-set reconcile

requirements.description: Persist readings and never verdicts, so in-band status is recomputed against the current deadband at query time and a target change re-grades history instead of stranding stale judgments.
requirements.title: Reading history and trend

requirements.description: Re-read a finding's named sensor after its downstream work lands and record whether the reading returned in band. A fix that does not move its sensor re-opens the finding, so the sensor grades the fix rather than its author.
requirements.title: Actuation efficacy

requirements.description: Diff the sensor map against the fleet's live command surface and report targets whose named sensor no longer resolves, plus open cells whose gap a shipped verb could already close.
requirements.title: Setpoint drift detection
